units.source_text: “虽然看起来是那伙计受了重伤，但是周围邻居反而更同情那学徒，真是难以理解。

en.t: At first glance, it seems that the young fellow was seriously injured, but the neighbors around him actually sympathize more with the apprentice; it is really hard to understand.

units.source_text: 此外，在通町三巷有一起，在新曲町二巷也有一起，还有什么地方也有一起。

en.t: Besides that, there was one case in the third lane of Tongmachi, another in the second lane of Shinkyokumachi, and yet another somewhere else.

units.source_text: 总而言之，很多地方都在发生类似的事情。

en.t: In short, the same sort of thing is happening in many places.

units.source_text: 据说都是在学咱们呢，奇怪不奇怪？”

en.t: They say everyone is copying us. Isn't that strange?
